description: This file provides utility functions for mapping categories or statuses to colors, specifically for use in dark-themed visualizations. It includes functions for generating deterministic pastel colors from strings and mapping common status values to themed colors.

methods.name: colorFromString(key, { saturation = 55, lightness = 55 } = {})
methods.description: Deterministically generates a pastel-modulated HSL color string from an input string, ensuring distinct hues for different strings suitable for dark backgrounds.

methods.name: getStatusColor(status, oc)
methods.description: Maps a given status string to a predefined theme color, or generates a deterministic color if the status is unrecognized, with special handling for common status categories.
